description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer_Reporting" name="Potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmploymentOutcome" name="Employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome" sourceRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Job applicant" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting" name="Receive potential job offer without reporting" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts" name="Continue with received offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSplit" name="Negotiate a job interview?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate job interview"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" name="Notify company that probation is complete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterRating_Split" name="Continue rating visibility and employment outcome paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" name="Receive employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyRating" name="Rated the company C or less?"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PermanentJob" name="Permanent job; process ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_JobSearch" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_Reporting" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOfferReceipts" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A job interview is negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNo" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToMerge" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_EnterProbation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AfterRating_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterRating_Split" targetRef="Event_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Event_OneYear" targetRef="End_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterRating_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyRating">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobNotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCLess" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The company rating is C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyRating" targetRef="End_PermanentJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportingEnded" name="Reporting obligation has ended" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingStatus" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer_NoReporting">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A previous permanent job ended reporting because the company rating was C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportingContinues" name="Reporting obligation continues" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingStatus" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Companies" name="Company application and employment workflow" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate job application"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?" default="Flow_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoOffer" name="No job offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate job applicant"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" name="Does the job become permanent?" default="Flow_NotPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" name="Send employment outcome" messageRef="Message_EmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmploymentOutcomeSent" name="Employment outcome sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferWanted" name="Company wants applicant to work for it" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The company wants the applicant to work for it</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOffer" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="End_NoOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotPermanent" name="Job does not become permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobBecomesPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_SendEmploymentOutcome" targetRef="End_EmploymentOutcomeSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
